info.title: Heartland Varmeoverblik
info.description: Monthly district heating consumption per installation for a company, worked out from Varmeoverblik's cumulative meter readings by Heartland's sync Function behind API Management, which holds each company's refresh token in Key Vault (docs/adr/0010).

get.summary: Get a company's monthly district heating consumption
get.description: Lists the company's installation points and works out each month's consumption from the meter readings at the month boundaries (Danish local time).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last month, YYYY-MM, inclusive; at most 24 months

403.description: The company's Varmeoverblik token is invalid or expired (error: token-invalid)

404.description: No Varmeoverblik token is stored for this CVR (error: token-missing)

429.description: Another sync is running; retry shortly (error: sync-running)

502.description: Varmeoverblik answered with an unexpected error (error: datahub-error)

503.description: Varmeoverblik kept rate-limiting after three retries; retry later (error: datahub-busy)

months.description: One entry per installation and month

darId.description: The address's UUID in DAR (Danmarks Adresseregister)

mwh.description: Rounded to 4 decimals; absent when flagged meter-reset or no-reading

skipped.description: Installation points that can't be read, e.g. the utility sends no data
